relationships.name: TikTok Pixel
relationships.difference: TikTok Pixel is the companion product whose ttp first-party cookie stores the unique identifiers on the advertiser's domain; this feature is the sharing of those stored identifiers with the Events API. Pixel is a condition for the sharing, not an equivalent or alternative to it.
relationships.context: Per the packet's single span, the sharing applies when the Events API is used alongside Pixel.
